title: TOOLS-002: `indigo_raw_crop` trusts the RAW header and ROI dimensions
description:
TOOLS-002: `indigo_raw_crop` trusts the RAW header and ROI dimensions. It does not validate the header read, RAW signature, positive crop width/height, multiplication overflow, allocation success, or payload read size. A truncated or crafted RAW file, or a crop like `0,0,-1,10`, can drive undersized allocation and out-of-bounds reads/writes. Validate the header and type, compute byte counts with overflow-checked `size_t`, require `width > 0 && height > 0`, and fail if reads or allocations are incomplete. Repaired and verified by task 20261024113017-1e1c-fix-fnd-000036-000037; see its verification and independent security reports.
